QUOTE: `app/routes/(authenticated)/thread.tsx` also passes `hasSearch={false}`, but it renders the lower-level `Header` from `app/components/navigation_header/header.tsx`, not `NavigationHeader`, so it is not a caller.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer excludes the thread route's `Header` from `navigation_header/header.tsx` as a renderer of NavigationHeader. It does not mention the navigation hook, but the item is about not counting `Header` renderers, and the thread route is one of the two it names.
